overview: The Medford City Council Committee of the Whole received a presentation from the Medford Arts Council and Arts Collaborative Medford regarding the state of arts and culture in the city. Participants discussed the need for a dedicated city arts liaison and increased financial investment to support local artists and community programming.

items.title: Resolution 26107: Presentation on Arts and Culture Support
items.summary: Approved a resolution to receive a status report from the Medford Arts Council and Arts Collaborative Medford on local grant demand and facility usage. Representatives and public speakers advocated for a dedicated city arts coordinator to manage logistical hurdles, such as permitting, and requested a permanent increase in the city's arts budget.
